vulnerability_context: An Owner Privilege Abuse vulnerability exists in the HubGameToken contract. The contract owner can unilaterally grant admin privileges using the `adminAdd` function. An admin can then execute the `initGame` function to mint a new supply of tokens, specifying themselves as the sole recipient for 100% of the newly created tokens.
winning_reflection: The crucial insight was recognizing that the admin-gated `initGame` function was not just for setup but also contained a minting mechanism. By first leveraging the owner's ability to add an admin via `adminAdd`, the attacker gained the necessary privileges to then call `initGame` and manipulate its parameters to mint and allocate the entire new token supply to their own address.
